run_when: Code found Mercury or Brex mentioned but couldn't confirm usage.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company itself uses Mercury or Brex for this purpose: banks with mercury or brex.
prompt.definition: Rarely public. Absence means nothing and must not count against the company.
yes_when: Job posts, 'how we work' posts or vendor lists say the company uses Mercury or Brex
no_when: The company names a different provider for this purpose
unknown_when: The tool is only named as an integration, investor or partner
watch_out_for: Integration and partner mentions are not usage
Brex or Mercury listed as investors is not usage
where_to_look: Blog posts about how they work

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

tools_used.description: Only tools the company itself uses, proven by the quote.

examples.input_excerpt: Our finance stack: Mercury for banking, Ramp for cards

output.reason: The company says it uses Mercury.
